device.title: iDevice
device.pairing_in_progress_hint: Please unlock your device and click "Trust," then enter your passcode if prompted.
device.wifi_search_none: Wi-Fi search: no device on the network answered.
device.wifi_search_unrecognised: Wi-Fi search: a device answered, but it doesn't trust this PC yet. Connect it with a cable once.

driver.missing_body: FlekPair can download it from Apple (about 200 MB) and install it. Windows will ask for permission once.
driver.alternative: Or install one of Apple's apps yourself, which brings the driver with it: ((link:https://www.apple.com/itunes/download/win64:download iTunes)) or get ((link:https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9np83lwlpz9k:Apple Devices)) from the Microsoft Store.
driver.stopped_body: FlekPair can start it. Windows will ask for permission.
driver.store_app_body: Leave it open and FlekPair will find your device.

pairing: Try reconnecting the device and running the action again.
Ensure your device has a passcode set.
Ensure your device is connected via USB, not wirelessly.
usbmuxd: [platform::windows]Ensure you have ((link:https://apple.co/ms:iTunes)) installed and check that it can detect your device.
[platform::windows]Uninstall iTunes and Apple Mobile Device Support, then install "Apple Devices" from the Microsoft Store.
[platform::linux]Make sure usbmuxd is installed and running.
trust: Unlock your device, go to the home screen, and accept any trust prompts that appear.
device_coms: Ensure your device is properly connected to your computer.
Unplug and reconnect the device. If the issue persists, try a different USB port and cable.
wifi: [platform::mac]To use Wi-Fi instead, wake and unlock a device that already trusts this Mac and keep it on the same network. It can take a minute or two to show up.
[platform::windows]To use Wi-Fi instead, wake and unlock a device that already trusts this PC and keep it on the same network. It can take a minute or two to show up.
misc: Try again. Restarting the app, your computer, and/or your phone may also help.
filesystem: Make sure FlekPair has permission to read and write files on your system.
